upper.description: The ruling elite who believe their trait expression is the purest form
upper.namingStyle: Grandiose and divine-sounding suffixes implying mastery and lordship

noble.description: The privileged class who serve as intermediaries to the upper class
noble.namingStyle: Elevated but not supreme, suggesting refinement and selection

middle.description: The aspiring class caught between privilege and struggle
middle.namingStyle: Functional and neutral, suggesting competence without distinction

common.description: The working masses who make up the bulk of society

lower.description: The marginalized class deemed unworthy by arbitrary trait standards
lower.namingStyle: Dismissive and diminutive, mocking their 'lack' of the trait

notes: Each trait provides 5 UNIQUE class name suffixes
Upper class names should sound grandiose and divine
Lower class names should sound diminutive but not offensive
Focus satire on arbitrary basis of hierarchy, not victims
All names should be clearly fictional/absurd
